name: The Neural Bloom
developmental_beat: Senses and coordination: the body reads its surroundings before moving.

obstacles.role: shaft wall whose ledge needs a second jump
tracking beam; either hidden with the veil or crossed by gliding above it
obstacles.fallback_until_implemented: Use a static slab as a line-of-sight blocker until tracking damage is built.

upgrade.name: Coordination — double-jump, glide, optional veil
upgrade.softlock_fallback: The veil is optional: every sensor route can also be crossed by glide or by the upper ledge.
upgrade.fallback_until_implemented: Use grip routes and the existing spike burst until the traversal upgrades are built.
upgrade.note: All three parts are owned; the veil is a solution, not a mandatory key.

boss.name: The Sentinel
boss.loop: Tracks the player's position and fires when the tracking beam locks on.
boss.weak_window: 1.5 s while its sensor iris recalibrates after firing.
boss.softlock_fallback: Two independent solutions exist: hide with the veil or break line of sight by gliding; the spike burst always damages the iris.
boss.fallback_until_implemented: Use the Rot Bloom telegraph loop until the tracking beam is built.
boss.solution: Hide or glide out of the beam, then burst the recalibrating iris.

future_resource.name: genetic material
future_resource.note: Trait flavour only; no traits or second meter are implemented here.

narrative.beat: A voice, distorted by fluid, seems to encourage movement; it is still unidentified.
